review_comment: I think we can always set within collapsed path to false on `remove()` can't we, because by definition if we're moving back up the object hierarchy then the object we're moving to can't be collapsed.  So maybe we can have just one method on ContentPath, `setCollapsed()`?
I think as things stand you can add a `subobjects` parameter to a nested object def, and we'll just ignore it.  Can we throw an error instead? And add a test asserting that we do so?
good catch thanks. I am now wondering if there are other properties that are valid for object for not for nested which we end up parsing and possibly ignoring.
